modeRequested: one-case production-budget discovery-only, AI and browser disabled
status: superseded by the guarded one-case run in revolut-discovery.json
reason: The production discovery crawl can continue making same-host requests after a challenged response: packages/core/src/discovery/discover.ts catches the blocked fetch as a null page, then probes hub pages, well-known paths and sitemaps up to the 40-fetch production cap. apps/worker/src/fetcher.ts marks HTTP 403 as blocked but does not stop the host for the rest of discovery. With an explicit challenge already observed, a live run would risk repeated attempts after that challenge.
